content.title: Barcelona vs Sevilla Lineups, Predictions, Live Streaming, How & Where to Watch, TV Channels
content.text: FC Barcelona will play at the Spotify Camp Nou in La Liga as they host Sevilla for their 28th league match of the season. Barcelona remains top of the league table, with Real Madrid and Atletico Madrid right below them.Barcelona is 1st with 67 points after 27 league matches played, and their record is 22 wins, one draw, and four losses. Sevilla is 15th in the league with 31 points and has a record of eight wins, seven draws, and 12 losses.Last weekend, Barcelona defeated Athletic Bilbao 1-0 away from home with a goal from Lamine Yamal. Sevilla drew 1-1 with Rayo Vallecano at the Estadio Ramon Sanchez Pizjuan. Expected Lineups for FC Barcelona and SevillaFC BarcelonaGoalkeeper: Joan GarciaDefenders: Joao Cancelo, Gerard Martin, Pau Cubarsi, Eric GarciaMidfielders: Pedri, Marc Casado, Dani OlmoForwards: Marcus Rashford, Ferran Torres, Lamine YamalSevillaGoalkeeper: Odysseas VlachodimosDefenders: Batista Mendy, Nemanja Gudelj, Tanguy Nianzou, Fabio CardosoMidfielders: Oso, Djibril Sow, Lucien Agoume, Juanlu SanchezForwards: Alexis Sanchez, Akor AdamsFC Barcelona vs Sevilla will kick off at 11:15 a.m. ET/ 8:15 a.m. PT in the United States.
